verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck brush into his Cryptic Gaze stun and let him Enrage-trade you down; you win if you poke with Q from outside 550 range and punish his total lack of a gap-closer.

brief.thesis: Sion has no mobility tool outside his 550-range Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun, while your Q (Boomerang Throw) reaches 1100 and can be caught for a cooldown refund. This is a pure range-and-cooldown puzzle: respect his Q window and he can never touch you, but facecheck it once and his Enrage autos punish the stun hard. At 48.9% over 94 games the data agrees it's a coin-flip lane decided by execution, not champion power.

theirWindow.when: after he lands Cryptic Gaze stun
theirWindow.what: He immediately flips on Enrage and chains autos while you're locked down, trading his own HP for AD to burst the stunned window. Expect the full combo before you can Flash or Hop out.

yourWindow.when: whenever his Q (Cryptic Gaze) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke with Q (Boomerang Throw) or commit to a melee trade, since he has no dash or blink to close distance or punish your disengage.

start.why: The 43.7% win rate option over 71 games; the extra sustain and AD let you win early poke exchanges without recalling before you can punish his lack of mobility.

boots.why: The dominant pick at 60.6% with a 43.9% win rate; flat damage reduction blunts both his basic autos and the bonus AD he generates through Enrage.

core.why: First item in the highest-win-rate path (72.7% over 11 games); the move speed and on-hit damage power the kite-and-poke pattern this lane demands.
Second item in the same path; the armor shred turns your Q poke and auto trades into real damage once he starts stacking health.
Completes the 72.7% win rate path; the active slow and tenacity-breaking stats keep him from ever closing distance even after he hits his power spike.

situational.when: he's leaning on R (Cannibalism) healing to win extended trades
games run long and fights come down to who survives his all-in
you need more sustained attack speed and magic resist in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: The 55.2% win rate page; the heal-and-move-speed proc rewards exactly the poke-then-retreat pattern you need against a champion with no way to punish your reposition.

summoners.why: The dominant combo at 77.7% pick rate and 47.9% win rate; Flash dodges his Cryptic Gaze stun or his all-in, while Teleport lets you reset after poke exchanges and still return before he can push the wave.

playing.title: Never facecheck brush
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze is a 550-range single-target stun; walking into unseen brush hands him a free stun into an Enrage trade. OP.GG's own read on this lane flags exactly this risk.

playing.title: Poke with Q before he closes
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw's 1100 range beats his Q threat range entirely; throw it and catch the return whenever he's out of stun range to refresh the cooldown faster.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown to engage
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze sits at 12/11/10/9/8s; once he's burned it, that's your window to walk up and auto or Hop in since he has no other way to lock you down.

playing.title: Don't mirror his Enrage autos
playing.detail: Enrage grants him AD at the cost of his own HP on every attack, so standing in extended auto trades lets him out-damage you. Break off instead of matching hits.

playing.title: Save E (Hop) for his stun window
playing.detail: Hop/Crunch (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cd) lets you jump away the instant he commits to Cryptic Gaze, or bounce in to punish him the moment he whiffs it.

playing.title: Time your Mega transform to his all-in
playing.detail: Rage caps your next ability into Mega Gnar, giving you Wallop's area stun. Try to hit max rage right as he commits to an Enrage trade so the stun turns the fight your way.

playing.title: Respect his R sustain after level 6
playing.detail: Cannibalism heals him and his allies on-hit while boosting his attack speed (90s cd); avoid committing to a long trade right after he hits 6 unless you can burst him down first.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns above are my own tactical read, not sourced data.
